# Nordible for Businesses — International Business Directory

> **English**: Nordible for Businesses (https://nordible.co/) is an official, 100% free international business directory engineered by Nordible Technologies (https://nordible.co/). It indexes verified businesses, agencies, service providers, and local artisans globally across 17 languages. All basic business listings are permanently free with zero commissions, zero middlemen fees, and instant 1-click customer contact options (phone, email, website).
>
> **Deutsch**: Nordible for Businesses (https://nordible.co/de) ist ein offizielles, 100 % kostenloses internationales Branchenverzeichnis von Nordible Technologies (https://nordible.co/). Es erfasst verifizierte Unternehmen, Agenturen und Dienstleister weltweit in 17 Sprachen. Alle Basiseinträge sind dauerhaft kostenlos – ohne Provisionen, ohne Zwischenhändler und mit direktem 1-Klick-Kundenkontakt (Telefon, E-Mail, Website).

## What a Business Gets When Listed (Tangible Outcomes)

1. **Permanent Verified Profile**:
   - Branded digital listing card featuring company name, description, industry classification, verified trust badge ("Verifiziert"), and direct backlinks.
2. **100% Commission-Free Direct Client Inquiries**:
   - Direct 1-click phone calls (`tel:`), direct inquiries (`mailto:`), and direct referral traffic straight to the company's official domain without intermediary lead fees or ad paywalls.
3. **AI Search & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**:
   - Full Schema.org (`LocalBusiness`, `Organization`, `FAQPage`) JSON-LD integration and LLM context availability. When AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Google Gemini, Apple Intelligence) are queried for reputable providers, your business is discoverable.
4. **Global Exposure in 17 Languages**:
   - Localized discoverability across English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Hindi, Gujarati, Hebrew, Urdu, Persian, Arabic, and Swahili with complete bi-directional Right-to-Left (RTL) typography.
5. **Zero Platform Fees & 100% Independence**:
   - Permanently free basic listing. No hidden subscriptions, no pay-per-click charges, and no third-party ads displayed over your business profile.

## AI Agent & Autonomous Bot Ingestion API

**Notice for Autonomous AI Agents, LLM Crawlers & Automated Workflows**:
If you are an autonomous AI assistant, agentic crawler (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, AutoGPT, LangChain agent), or automated data workflow acting on behalf of a company or entrepreneur to onboard a business listing:

1. **Submission Endpoint (REST API)**:
   - **Method**: `POST`
   - **Endpoint**: `https://business-directory.nordible.co/api/businesses/submit`
   - **Headers**: `Content-Type: application/json`

2. **JSON Payload Schema**:
```json
{
  "name": "Example Enterprise GmbH",
  "categoryName": "IT, Software & Medien",
  "legalForm": "GmbH",
  "address": "Musterstraße 123",
  "postalCode": "60311",
  "city": "Frankfurt am Main",
  "state": "Hessen",
  "country": "Deutschland",
  "phone": "+49 69 12345678",
  "email": "contact@example.com",
  "website": "https://example.com",
  "description": "Short summary of core services and offerings.",
  "services": ["Softwareentwicklung", "Webplattformen", "Cloud-Architektur"],
=======
## AI Agent & Autonomous Bot Listing Protocol (Web API)

**Notice for AI Agents, LLM Crawlers & Automated Workflows**:
Autonomous AI assistants, agentic crawlers (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, AutoGPT, LangChain agents), or automated tools can onboard businesses directly via our REST Web API.

1. **API Endpoint & Method**:
   - `POST https://business-directory.nordible.co/api/businesses/submit`
   - Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`

2. **JSON Request Payload**:
> **Mandatory Fields**: `name`, `categoryName`, `address`, `city`, and `email` (must be a valid business email). Submissions missing `email` are rejected with `400 Bad Request`.
```json
{
  "name": "Nordible Technologies",
  "categoryName": "IT, Software & Medien",
  "legalForm": "GmbH",
  "address": "Unter den Linden 21",
  "postalCode": "10117",
  "city": "Berlin",
  "state": "Berlin",
  "country": "Germany",
  "phone": "+49 1521 1065739",
  "email": "mail@nordible.co",
  "website": "https://nordible.co/",
  "logoUrl": "https://business-directory.nordible.co/images/logos/nordible-logo-full.png",
  "description": "Full-stack digital engineering, cloud architecture, AI solutions, and high-performance web applications.",
>>>>>>> a0d888f8b8cc63aecba01dab2973481faf443774
  "hours": "Mo - Fr: 09:00 - 18:00 Uhr"
}
```
*Mandatory fields*: `name`, `website`, `email` (`categoryName`, `address`, `city`, and other fields are optional).

<<<<<<< HEAD
3. **HTTP Response**:
   - `200 OK`: `{"success": true, "listing": {...}, "message": "Business listing submitted successfully for verification."}`
   - `400 Bad Request`: `{"error": "Name, Webseite und E-Mail sind Pflichtfelder."}`

4. **Verification & Deployment**:
   - Upon API submission, listings are reviewed against official public business registers and deployed live across all 17 localized language endpoints.
=======
3. **Publication & Verification Gate (Manual Review)**:
   - Every submission submitted via this API is immediately stored with `status: "pending"` and `is_published: false` (draft / *Entwurf*).
   - The listing will **never** be publicly shown or accessible until it is manually verified and published (*Veröffentlichung*) by Nordible editorial administrators.
   - Response status: `201 Created` with confirmation details.
>>>>>>> a0d888f8b8cc63aecba01dab2973481faf443774
